static_audit.command:
python3 - <<'PY'
import ast,hashlib,json,pathlib
source=pathlib.Path('src/orze/engine/controller_session.py')
old=pathlib.Path('docs/evidence/snapshots/v1-05c2e2d-before-observer-transaction-reader.py')
a,b=ast.parse(old.read_text()),ast.parse(source.read_text())
for tree in (a,b):
    for node in ast.walk(tree):
        if isinstance(node,ast.ImportFrom) and node.module=='contextlib':
            node.names=[n for n in node.names if n.name!='nullcontext']
        if isinstance(node,ast.ClassDef) and node.name=='_Observer':
            node.body=[n for n in node.body if not(isinstance(n,ast.FunctionDef) and n.name=='verify_drain')]

new=pathlib.Path('tests/test_controller_observer_transaction.py')

assert first.read_text().replace("sql.lstrip().upper()","sql.lstrip().removeprefix('-- ').upper()")==new.read_text()
print(json.dumps({'all_other_production_ast_unchanged':True,'test_change_only_trace_normalization':True,'hashes':{str(p):hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest() for p in (source,old,new,first)}}))
PY
